description: Replace the external-panel entry token for an owned BYOP study. The old provider link stops working immediately; update the provider with the returned entry_url. idempotency_key.description: Reuse the same key and inputs if a prior call timed out. A different operation needs a new key.

organization_id.description: Platform admins only: select an organization for this operation. Required when changing another organization’s study or using its wallet.

result.description: Configuration with a new entry URL.
